description: This repo is public. Mend does not apply the org config (aignostics/renovate-config, org-inherited-config.json)
to public repos. This file ports the org keys that this repo needs. The Renovate defaults already match
the org values for prCreation, internalChecksFilter and minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour.
rebaseWhen conflicted: a rebase pushes to the PR branch, and the org ruleset then dismisses the approval.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A vulnerability fix skips minimumReleaseAge. No automerge: a person checks the fix before the merge.

description: Pinned PyPI packages in mise tasks, for example: uv tool install keyring==25.7.0 --with pkg==1.2.3.
This repo is public, so the org custom managers do not apply here.
From the org config. Digest, pinDigest and lock file maintenance updates have no release timestamp.
Under timestamp-required, they stay pending forever and never automerge (renovatebot/renovate#45236).
Remove this rule when renovatebot/renovate#46645 is released.
One PR for each Python minor or major update: requires-python and .python-version.
Without this rule, requires-python goes into the pep621 group alone and CI tests the old .python-version.
Keep this rule after the pep621 group rule. No automerge: a person adds the classifier and accepts the PR.
Widen requires-python: raise only the upper bound. The default strategy also raises the lower bound,
and a dropped Python version is a breaking change for this library.
